newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius Commercial Bank interim profit up 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius Commercial Bank interim profit up 15 pct.

text.p: Mauritius Commercial Bank reported on Thursday a 15 percent rise in interim pre-tax profit of 408.0 million rupees ($20.3 million) for the six months ended 31 December 1996 from 354.5 million rupees during the corresponding period in 1995.

Interest income at the largest banking group in Mauritius went up to 2.03 billion rupees for the six months ended 31 December 1996 from 1.86 billion rupees the corresponding period of 1995, bank officials said.
The officials said that profit after tax climbed to 303.9 million rupees for the half year ended 31 December 1996 from 245.1 million rupees the corresponding period in 1995.
Deposits at the Mauritius Commercial Bank totalled 34.2 billion rupees as at 31 December 1996 from 32.2 billion rupees one year earlier.
